subject: [PATCH v2 3/4] selftests/mm: check collapse results through check_huge() only

2026-10-09.patch_summary: This patch simplifies the way khugepaged checks collapse results by using a single callback function, check_huge(), to handle all cases. It removes redundant code and private descriptors, making the code more consistent and easier to maintain. The patch also updates several self-test files to use the new approach.
